biotools.summary: Bvalcalc is a command-line tool that analytically calculates the expected genome-wide B-value, quantifying how purifying selection (Background Selection) reduces genetic diversity compared to strict neutrality. It is applicable for population genomic inference across model and non-model species.
biotools.name: Bvalcalc: B-value Calculator
